My experience has been pretty much 70/30 a good experience, I have somehow ALWAYS managed to get through within 5 minutes in the morning for same day appointments and i’ve almost always been seen the same day. They have some incredible doctors and staff who genuinely have changed my life for the better but sadly some have really missed manage me to the point it’s affected my health for the worse. But i can promise when you get a good doctor for the ward i can’t express how good it can be and my honest to god only two complaints is issues ordering prescription wither i call in or use the website and the times i have had over the phone calls where i have been flat out told conflicting information from my regular GP’s.
